name: cgmes-cim-hints
description: Completions, hovers and validation for CIM/XML instance files following CGMES 2.4.15, CGMES 3.0 and ENTSO-E network code profiles (NCP) 2.2 and 2.5.

commands.title: Select CIM version for this file
Choose the files to validate together

cgmes.version.description: CIM version used for hints: "auto" detects it from namespaces and the header, or a bundle id such as "cgmes-2.4.15", "cgmes-3.0", "ncp-2.2" or "ncp-2.5".

cgmes.schemaFolders.markdownDescription: Extra RDFS (and optional SHACL .ttl) folders to load, e.g. `[{"folder": "C:/schemas/ncp/2.4.1", "label": "NC profiles 2.4.1", "id": "ncp-2.4.1"}]`. A folder with the same `id` as a bundled package replaces it.

cgmes.propertyReferenceList.markdownDescription: File with the ENTSO-E PropertyReference list (http://energy.referencedata.eu/PropertyReference/) in any text form: RDF/XML, Turtle, JSON, HTML, CSV or one `Class.property` per line. NC `PropertyReference` values are checked against it by their property name only, whatever namespace they use. Without it, the name is checked against the properties of the loaded CIM profiles. A relative path is read from the first workspace folder.

cgmes.idStyle.description: Identifier style for new objects: rdf:ID="_uuid" (CGMES 2.4.15 and 3.0) or rdf:about="urn:uuid:..." (NC profiles). "auto" follows the file, then the version default.

cgmes.completion.insertRequiredPropertie.description: When inserting a new object, also insert its required properties.

cgmes.validation.enabled.description: Show profile diagnostics for CIM/XML files.

cgmes.validation.identifierFormat.description: Check that identifiers are "_" + UUID or urn:uuid:...

cgmes.validation.propertyReferences.markdownDescription: Check NC `PropertyReference` values (by their `Class.property` name) against the list in `#cgmes.propertyReferenceList#`, the bundled ENTSO-E list, or the properties of the loaded CIM profiles when no list is available.

cgmes.validation.unresolvedReferences.description: How to report references to objects that are not in the same file when they cannot be checked against the folder (cross-file checks off, no other CIM files there, or a model the file depends on, such as the boundary set, is not there).

cgmes.validation.danglingReferences.description: How to report references (and rdf:about descriptions) to objects found neither in the file nor in the other CIM files of its folder, when every model the file depends on is there.

cgmes.crossFile.enabled.description: Check references against the other CIM files in the same folder (a CGM's EQ, SSH, TP, SV; NC profiles such as AE, RA, CO, SIS). The folder is indexed in the background and kept current when files change.

cgmes.crossFile.extraFolders.description: More folders whose CIM files take part in cross-file checks, e.g. the folder with the boundary set or the EQ the NC files point to. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace.

cgmes.crossFile.maxTotalSizeMB.description: Stop indexing a folder once its CIM files add up to this size (MB).

cgmes.crossFile.maxValidateSizeMB.description: Files of a selected dataset that are not open are validated from disk up to this size (MB). Larger ones only resolve references; open them to validate them.
